From: Jordan Miles <jordan@compile.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request via docs quickstart — technical review requested

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the docs/quickstart flow — we spun up a trial and have been running some inference against a few embeddings and chat endpoints. Early results look promising but a few things are blocking us from moving forward:

- We want to understand throughput limits (token/sec) for bursts vs. sustained traffic.
- Need guidance on prefix caching and KV cache reuse across short-lived sessions.
- Curious whether Dedicated would be required for our 50 req/s peak or if clever batching + caching on Hosted makes sense.

I attached a small traffic snapshot (compile_traffic_snapshot.csv) with our baseline and a sample request profile. Could we do a short technical walkthrough with someone from your runtime team? Prefer afternoons PDT this week — Thu 6/25 or Fri 6/26 would work.

Attendees from our side: me (Jordan) and Aisha Gupta (backend engineer).

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Platform
Compile.AI

---

We’ll bring Aisha (backend) and Ravi (ML infra lead) — Ravi will join if his calendar frees up. Also would appreciate a short note on expected token-cost per hour for both Hosted with caching and for a 4-GPU Dedicated pool — just rough numbers ahead of the session to set expectations.
